overview: He sells drugs to the Foxtrot network, but refuses to help murder the gang leader's relative. In the midst of the bloody wave of violence, he turns to the police instead. In an apartment with two torpedoes, he bets everything on the task force to intervene. He is the gang member who became a golar. Investigative series by Mattias Sandberg.
title: Dokument inifrån: Golaren

overview: Where the rubber meets the road and the bad guys meet the badge -- that's where you'll find California Highway Patrol motorcycle officers Jon and Ponch. Set in the sun-drenched sprawl of Los Angeles, CHiPs combines action, heroics and fun.
title: CHiPs

overview: The Top Secret Life of Edgar Briggs was a 30-minute British television comedy series created by Bernard McKenna & Richard Laing and produced by Humphrey Barclay for LWT. It was transmitted on the ITV network 15 September - 20 December 1974 and featured David Jason as the inept Edgar Briggs, personal assistant to the Commander of the British Secret Intelligence Service who, in spite of his cluelessness, manages to solve case after case. It has been likened to the earlier American series Get Smart.
title: The Top Secret Life of Edgar Briggs

overview: You'll finally see Gabby's never-before-seen audition tape… and trust us, it's pure gold. Ex-winners Claudia and Austen join the show. Plus, the producers are in the Hot Seat!
title: Love Island Australia Officially Unpacked

overview: Nina Vavilova is a talented guide, she conducts city tours and fights for historical monuments. She's been happily married for a long time. Her husband Artem is Nina's fulcrum and the only person she absolutely trusts. It seems to her that without him she would not be able to live a day. But a tragic accident turns her whole life upside down. One day Artem gets into a car accident together - with his second family-his common-law wife Masha and little daughter Katya.
title: Сильная ты

overview: This is the story about a person born during the time of WW2 evacuation and who quickly turned from a modest Jewish boy Joseph into a cruel and cynical crowned thief, ruthless to everyone. The person, who once lost, forgot, traded his present name by becoming simply a Baron... Streets of modern city are changed into wooden pavements of a provincial town in the beginning of 50th, high society parties are turned into gangsters' meetings, Mediterranean landscapes - into dirty railway stations of Russian suburbs, detective's office of Stalin times - into a high security prison of 70th.
title: По имени Барон

overview: Heroes of different social groups and ages try to find a solution to the problem, "living" several options for the development of their destiny, each time returning to the beginning from the same moment, key for a given situation. The heroes will get three attempts to find the correct solution. In this they are helped by two Guardians - Alexander Gordon and Ksenia Lavrova-Glinka, they enjoy their freedom and at the same time envy people a little. In their parallel world there is no time and no physical sensations, but only spirit and thought.
title: Судьба на выбор

overview: In the beginning of the 20th century the Russian Empire faces a new threat - political terrorism. To fight it a new secret service is set up. Experienced agents and detectives oppose the blood-thirsty "revolutionaries" and fanatics.
title: Секретная служба Его Величества

overview: Nine-year-old Petka Odintsov, a smart aleck, has no friends, but he does have his grandmother, Aurora Alexandrovna. In such company, Petka's future is at risk. He has no prospects other than books and lessons. But one day, Petka commits a heroic act, and a tabby cat, Vaska, appears in the Odintsov household. The Odintsovs' lives change dramatically—the grandmother declares war on Vaska.
title: Полосатое счастье

overview: An unknown group, calling themselves "Temnaya Loshadka" ("Dark Horse") routinely assassinate inconvenient people. Everyone from federal security services to victims' friends and a local policeman try to tackle them.
title: Тёмная лошадка

overview: In any weather, on weekdays and holidays, there's a line at the Pokrovsky Convent: hundreds of women come here, to the relics of Saint Matrona, hoping for a miracle. And miracles do happen! Even 63 years after her death, Matrona of Moscow never misses a single request: terminally ill patients recover, and those desperate to give birth become mothers. In the new documentary series «Effekt Matrony» we'll tell 20 amazing stories that happened to those who turned to the saint for help. Each episode is the true story of a woman who, in one way or another, encountered Matrona of Moscow. She appeared to some in dreams, some went to church and prayed, some lost consciousness and Matrona appeared to them... Stories of life, love, betrayal, infidelity... Matrona helped some mend their relationships with their husbands, and she guided others on the right path in finding a criminal...
title: Эффект Матроны

overview: It's spring in Moscow. The May Day celebrations have just ended, and the country is still reeling from one holiday, preparing for the next – Victory Day. Everyone is in a state of bliss and tranquility, awaiting the warm summer. Only the post office is working hard – letters, cards, newspapers, packages, and parcels are arriving in an endless stream. There aren't enough people, everyone is exhausted, tired, and irritated. The protagonist, a simple postal worker named Gerasim, is also running around like a squirrel in a wheel. Five years ago, he lost his brother, and with him, any hope for justice in this life. One day, one of the old ladies he delivered mail to is murdered. Gerasim begins his own investigation, during which he meets Nastya, a modest girl who becomes both a loyal assistant and a lover. But then, prosecutor Bizyak stands in our heroes' way. The indefatigable postman sticks his nose into everything, for which the law enforcement officer punishes him by jailing him for a while. Some time later, Gerasim is promoted at work, but he asks to postpone his "career advancement" while the investigation continues.
title: Почтальон

overview: Marina Leonidova lives with her daughters and mother in a private house in the small town of Yuryatin. Local businessman Kovrov plans to build a shopping center on the site of her house. Kovrov invites Marina and her family to move to a city apartment, but she refuses and intends to fight for her home to the end.
title: Аисты счастья

overview: A series of films about the most famous CIA and KGB spies
title: Шпионы и предатели

overview: The recent past—from the beginning of perestroika until almost the present day. A time of turmoil, a period of capital accumulation, showdowns, a reassessment of all old values, the acquisition of new ones... The film's heroes, along with the entire country, begin a new life in the mid-1980s, swiftly breaking through all the trials the era has in store. They are not constrained by excessive moral principles, but with every step they take in their pursuit of enormous wealth, they take sin upon their souls and are aware of it.
title: Игры в подкидного

overview: Cosmonautics is a great achievement of a great country! On October 4, 1957, the USSR launched the world's first artificial satellite, Sputnik, and less than four years later, the first human spaceflight took place. Over these 55 years, Yuri Gagarin was joined by 119 more cosmonauts. As of March 2016, exactly 120 of our compatriots have contributed to the exploration of space, and each of them is undoubtedly a hero and a legend. Just like the brilliant scientists who brought recent science fiction to life. The "Legends of Space" series is dedicated to these people, as well as to the most significant events in the history of Russian cosmonautics. This story will not only be about the familiar heroes of the Soviet era—Gagarin, Tereshkova, Titov, Leonov, Grechko, Savitskaya—but also about those who have found themselves beyond the Earth in the 21st century: Russian cosmonauts and scientists. What are these heroes like, not only in orbit but also in their lives on Earth? These are perhaps the two main questions that the "Legends of Space" series will answer.
title: Легенды космоса

overview: In April 1943, Stalin received a secret document – a plan for the German Operation Citadel. The Wehrmacht was preparing a large-scale offensive, but the Führer's signature was missing. Could intelligence data and the authenticity of secret documents be trusted? How should the correct decision be made – to attack and attempt to inflict serious damage on the German armies, depriving them of the strength to launch an attack, or to defend and risk the possibility of failing to hold the lines? Nikolai Vatutin insisted that an attack was necessary without delay. Konstantin Rokossovsky insisted that it was essential to hold the line. Why did headquarters accept one point of view and reject the other? Which side did Marshal Zhukov support? The same dilemma – to attack or to defend – tormented the German headquarters. Among the German generals, there were those who even then realized that an attack on the USSR would be a fatal mistake. Why weren't they listened to? How did the newest German tank, the Tiger, end up at the Kubinka testing ground? What kind of blows did its armor withstand, and were its weak points discovered? What other "surprises" did the German military industry have in store, and how did the Soviet army have to defend itself?
title: Курская дуга

overview: 2019. Mongolian steppes. Khalkhin Gol. 80 years ago, thousands of Soviet and Mongolian soldiers and officers met their death on this land. Why did they fight the Japanese hundreds of kilometers from the USSR border? Why did the Kwantung Army come from Japan to these steppes? And why is Mongolia still grateful to the Soviet Marshal of Victory Georgy Zhukov? That long-gone conflict at Khalkhin Gol is still viewed differently in Russia, Mongolia, and Japan. But everyone agrees on one thing: the victory of the Soviet-Mongolian forces on these steppes changed the course of world history!
title: Подвиг на Халхин-Голе

overview: A collection of films featuring all the mythical creatures mentioned in legends and stories. The creators of the series traveled around the world, collecting stories and eyewitness accounts.
title: Нечисть

overview: No, That's Me Over Here! was a British sitcom that aired for three series from 1967 to 1970. It was created by Barry Cryer, Graham Chapman and Eric Idle, and it featured Ronnie Corbett's first acting starring role, alongside Rosemary Leach, Henry McGee (who was at the time also playing straight man to Benny Hill in The Benny Hill Show), Ivor Dean and Jill Mai Meredith. It was originally made by Associated-Rediffusion for the ITV network, with its production being continued by London Weekend Television for the third and final series.
title: No, That's Me Over Here!

overview: Several stories from the lives of children from one yard.
title: Ребята с нашего двора

overview: It traces the atrocities of Unit 731's biological and chemical warfare, reflects on history's scars, and prays for humanity's peace.
title: Man's Inhumanity to Man
Fan Pai Qian Jin Shang Wei Ji

overview: A youth romance that takes place when the Department of Computer Engineering and the Department of Modeling are merged.
title: The 4th Love Revolution

overview: When Sheila Haddon's husband dies without any insurance, on top of her grief, she has to pay off the mortgage of her house (No 20). To do this, rather than ask for help, she decides to take in young lodgers.
title: All at Number 20

overview: Dilek, a mother of two who lives apart from her husband but is not yet divorced, works as an unlicensed taxi driver to make a living. One day, she picks up a passenger who's taking an illegal taxi for the first time and they get caught in a police check. After losing her car, Dilek finds herself cornered by pressure from her husband and family during the divorce process. But she refuses to give up. Just when she's about to lose hope, the passenger from that day, Şadi, offers her a job as his driver. Accepting the offer pulls Dilek into a dark and dangerous world, where she will uncover hidden talents and ultimately change her own destiny.
title: FER

overview: A psychological thriller series that questions the concepts of crime, identity, and reality. The story revolves around a man forced to confront his past and his struggle with his inner self. The main character's inner collapse leads the audience into the dark corridors of the human mind.
title: Persona

overview: The film tells the story of the fate of the Tsarskoye Selo palaces from the moment the Romanov family left them until the beginning of the Great Patriotic War.
title: Дворцы взорвать и уходить...

overview: The Greatest Average American is a hilarious new game show that celebrates the power of being perfectly average. Each round is packed with laugh-out-loud challenges and trivia as contestants try to guess how everyday Americans think and live. In the end, one lucky player will be crowned the Greatest Average American and get the chance to win the ultimate grand prize: the average American salary of $67,920.
title: The Greatest Average American

overview: Discover the underwater landscape where aquatic species have evolved.
title: Ocean Wild

overview: The forest watches as two sisters confront personal truths - and what lurks in the dark.
title: Eyes In The Woods

overview: It's bite at first sight in an iconic union! Culinary competitiveness meets marriage mayhem, as five Married at First Sight UK marvels battle it out to win a £1000 cash prize for charity.
title: MAFS UK Does Come Dine with Me

overview: Peter Barnes is a man for whom innumerable problems appear to crop up just in proceeds of everyday "getting things done". From trying to secure a small loan to being a best man, life seems to hand Peter - and by extension, his wife, Sheila - more than his fair share of obstacles and frustrations. The only certainty is that whatever he's trying to do or arrange, it will entail an encounter with a jobsworth whose instinctive response is a perfectly timed sharp intake of breath.
title: A Sharp Intake of Breath

overview: A 6-part documentary project about a grand automobile expedition across the entire Asian continent. Seven countries, 14,000 km, through deserts and mountains. Starting in Astrakhan and finishing in Blagoveshchensk.
title: Транс-азиатская экспедиция AMAROK
РОКовая ночь с Александром Ф. Скляром

overview: The documentary series "The History of Russian Food" offers viewers the opportunity to learn so many surprising things about seemingly familiar subjects that they'll rightfully ask: why has Russian television so far ignored the history of national cuisine? For example, is it true that a feast during the time of Ivan the Terrible began with hundreds of roasted swans? Why were Russian medieval feasts criticized by foreigners? How was the monarch protected from poisoning? Or how did the concept of "tipping" come into being? What did "drinking from someone's face" mean? What did lean years mean for Rus'? How did Russians escape the famine caused by crop failure? And, in general, how did Russian cuisine develop and evolve over the centuries? Where did certain foods originate that have become an integral part of the national menu? Why have so many foods and drinks disappeared from our lives? What kind of dish is "perm," and where did the strange saying "No problem – quinoa" come from?
title: История русской еды

overview: Cold. We encounter it every day. But we still don't know what it is we're really dealing with. What threat does global warming pose to the world? Why did they try to build an aircraft carrier out of ice during World War II? What can frozen water samples recovered from subglacial Lake Vostok tell scientists? How has cold influenced the birth and destruction of entire civilizations? Two years of filming took place around the world – in Russia, Norway, the UK, the US, and, of course, on the coldest continent on the planet. What did it look like before? Is it true that Antarctica's ice is slowly melting? The filmmakers sought answers to these questions on expeditions and in research labs, where they conducted complex experiments. "Without ice and snow, there would be no ocean currents; the oceans would be deprived of oxygen, meaning there would be no life. The presence of ice determines the temperature difference between the poles and the equatorial regions; this temperature difference generates air currents in the atmosphere that shape the planet's climate," explains Magnus Magnusson, Scientific Secretary of the International Glaciological Society. "In short, life on Earth would be impossible without cold, snow, and ice."
title: Холод

overview: Does extraterrestrial intelligence exist, or is it just a figment of science fiction? In search of an answer, a film crew travels to eight of the planet's most mysterious locations where alien contact signals have been reported.
title: В поисках НЛО
Марк Захаров: мое настоящее, прошлое и будущее

overview: Husbands sometimes leave their wives, and wives sometimes leave their husbands. That's life. For some, it's a relief; for others, it's a tragedy. For the film's heroine, the separation from her husband was a huge stress, as she had been selflessly in love with her chosen one. Her friends offer various ways to get her husband back, but none of them work for our heroine—she's fundamentally incapable of lying or pretending. And most importantly, she'll never be able to deceive herself. The woman understands well that love is dead and there's nothing she can do about it. But it's true that the most incredible wishes come true on New Year's. And the abandoned wife learns this firsthand—just when she thought life had lost all meaning.
title: С новым счастьем!

overview: Hosts Vladimir Pozner and Ivan Urgant go to England to tell about the magnificent pages of history and modernity of the largest administrative unit of the UK state.
title: Англия в общем и в частности

overview: The story of four women who lost their husbands under very strange circumstances. Desperate for justice, the widows band together to find the killer themselves. They support each other, because life has not stopped. The business left behind by their deceased husbands requires management, and problems arise that the women will have to solve on their own. In addition, they meet other men along the way, and the women must discover whether it is possible to find happiness again.
title: Женщины и прочие неприятности

overview: To prevent Iran from going nuclear, intelligence officer John Tavner must forgo all safety nets and assume a perilous "non-official cover" -- that of a mid-level employee at a Midwestern industrial piping firm.
title: Patriot

overview: A series about the fate of one of Moscow's most celebrated districts – Arbat Street and its surrounding area. The very word "Arbat" has become a symbol of intelligence, masculinity, and decency. The development of this remarkable district is traced through generations of "Arbat boys," beginning with Lermontov and Herzen. A unifying theme is the life of one of the most famous "Arbat boys" of the 20th century – artist Boris Birger, a friend of many Arbat residents, from Okudzhava to Sakharov. Through his life and work, the common traits of the "Arbat character" are revealed.
title: Арбатские мальчики

overview: Recently elected mayor Selivanov visits his predecessors, learning about their difficult lives. The stories of these former mayors about themselves and their lives, closely intertwined with the country's history, form the basis of this four-part series. The former mayor tells the current mayor about a tragic event that befell him. Sedykh's son, a tenth-grade student, created an underground organization, which he used to terrorize the entire school. In doing so, he clearly copied the practices his father had established in the executive committee. Sedykh learned of the incident from his teacher, Galina Chernyaeva, and, fearing a scandal, suggested that she hush up the matter. Chernyaeva refused. The conflict between the all-powerful mayor and the teacher ended unexpectedly: they fell in love.
title: Непредвиденные визиты

overview: A film about the lives, characters, and attitudes of workers at a large printing house, who combine work with treatment and rest in a sanatorium.
title: Месяц длинных дней

overview: The story is about how two young, attractive girls, Sveta and Tanya, who live in rented apartment No. 7 on the second floor of an apartment building in Moscow, are forced to look for a third tenant who would share all the utility costs with them. They come across a handsome guy named Kostya, who is also an excellent cook, as he is studying to become a chef. The only obstacle to their happy alliance is the apartment owner, Semyon Kuzmich, who lives with his wife, Inna Pavlovna, on the floor below; they are both pensioners. Their views on life are, to put it mildly, old‑fashioned, and their declared morality borders on militant hypocrisy. The girls have to resort to a trick – they convince the owner that the guy is gay.
title: Трое сверху

overview: Four main characters with different interests, future plans and problems are studying at the same school. They are not children anymore, but not adults yet. Before starting a grown up life each of them needs to make important decisions.
title: Старшеклассники

overview: At Last the 1948 Show is a satirical TV show made by David Frost's company, Paradine Productions, in association with Rediffusion London. Transmitted on Britain's ITV network from February 15, 1967. The show starred Tim Brooke-Taylor, Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Marty Feldman and Aimi MacDonald. Cleese and Brooke-Taylor were also the programme editors.
title: At Last the 1948 Show

overview: A seven-hour epic adaptation of the novel by Leo Tolstoy. The love story of young Countess Natasha Rostova and Count Pierre Bezukhov is interwoven with the Great Patriotic War of 1812 against Napoleon's invading army.
title: Война и Мир

overview: The author's cycle of the famous theater and film actor Leonid Filatov, dedicated to the actors of Soviet and Russian cinema who passed away. Aleksandr Kaidanovsky and Rolan Bykov, Vladimir Vysotsky and Innokenty Smoktunovsky, Oleg Dal and Inna Gulaya became heroes of the issues - and many others.The last program was dedicated to the author himself and the presenter - Leonid Filatov. She aired on December 4, 2003. The filming of the documentary cycle was completed due to the death of the presenter.
title: Чтобы помнили

overview: The film tells about the beginning of the construction of the Baikal-Amur Mainline.
title: Лучшая дорога нашей жизни

overview: A story about the last two days of Mayakovsky's life and some episodes of the previous time.
title: Маяковский. Два дня

overview: The film is based on real events, happened in the beginning of WW2 in august 1941 in Belorussia.
title: Последний бронепоезд

overview: Mann's Best Friends was a Channel 4 comedy about the misfit residents of a lodging house, their landlord, and the ex-water board official who moves in to try to bring some order. Henry Mann (Barry Stanton) is the owner of The Laurels, a rundown guest house populated by a motley crew of odd characters. Hamish Ordway (Fulton Mackay), who has recently retired from his job at the water board, moves into The Laurels. He's a pompous, fussy, nosy little man who loves interfering in everyone else's business. Other residents include an alcoholic named Duncan (Bernard Bresslaw) and a blonde "drama tutor" named Dolly Delights (Patricia Burke), who likes to entertain lots of "gentlemen callers" in her room.
title: Mann's Best Friends
